truth: control/truth_monomers.tsv and control/truth_hors.tsv, exact engineered coordinate ledger
truth_scope: synthetic centromere-like 171-bp monomers, 40 HOR copies, four engineered length/order variants; not biological or held-out truth
shared_input_policy: Each assembly-only tool receives exactly the same FASTA, no oracle monomer file and no reads. The candidate_monomers.fa truth file is withheld.
resource_policy: One CPU requested in each native command; sequential runs; profile_stage_resources.py sampling at 0.2 s on same Mac host, process-tree RSS and wall clock. Profiler requires permission to inspect ps on macOS; zero RSS samples are invalid and must be disclosed. Runtime includes each configured full stage; no cross-host speed claim.

TideCluster.hor_order_endpoint: N/A: these two stages do not emit monomer/HOR label order; full TAREAN/KITE is a distinct unrun pipeline

TandemX.assembly_only_hor_endpoint: N/A unless a method runs with the same FASTA and no supplied truth-derived monomer templates

primary_metrics.array_recall_bp: truth array bp overlapped by union of predicted array intervals / truth array bp
primary_metrics.array_precision_bp: predicted array bp overlapping truth array / all predicted array bp
primary_metrics.monomer_length_error_bp: absolute error of the dominant predicted monomer length against 171; unavailable if method does not emit monomer calls
primary_metrics.monomer_partition_pair_f1: pairwise same-family F1 on truth copies with one-to-one >=0.5 reciprocal overlap to native decomposition intervals; unavailable if no unit-level calls
primary_metrics.hor_unit_length_error_bp: absolute error against 855 bp canonical HOR, only if native output declares a HOR unit
primary_metrics.hor_variant_recall: exact or documented compatible native variant HOR calls matched to four injected variants; unavailable if native output lacks coordinates/order
primary_metrics.runtime_seconds: wall clock from shared process-tree profiler
primary_metrics.peak_process_tree_rss_mib: maximum sampled sum of process-tree RSS, subject to 0.2 s sampling

failure_policy: Retain native outputs and stderr. Exit 0 without correct structure remains a failed accuracy result; process failure is technical unavailable, never scored as accuracy zero. No parameter tuning after truth inspection.
